reel.caption:
Debt fund held for 5 years: why is the tax still the same?

For debt fund units bought on or after 1 April 2023, gains are taxed at your income-tax slab rate, however long you hold them.
There is no long-term rate and no indexation for these units, so 6 months or 6 years makes no difference.
At the 30% slab, an illustrative ₹1 lakh gain means ₹30,000 tax before cess. At the 10% slab it is ₹10,000.
Units bought before 1 April 2023 follow the older rules.
